description: This file defines API routes for managing campaigns, prompts, leaderboards, and prompt submissions using FastAPI. It includes in-memory sample data and database interactions for leaderboards and prompt submissions.

methods.name: get_active_campaigns( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve current active campaigns based on the system time.

methods.name: get_writing_prompts( campaign_id: Optional[int] = None, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve writing prompts, optionally filtered by campaign ID.

methods.name: get_campaign_leaderboard( campaign_id: Optional[int] = None, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the top authors based on post counts for a campaign leaderboard.

methods.name: submit_prompt_response( prompt_id: int, post_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint to submit a blog post as a response to a specific writing prompt.
